goal: Allow separate executables like an isolated wallet to access chain state and submit transactions over IPC
Enable running node and wallet components across separate processes or hosts
agreement: Blocked by unaddressed objection: external client errors during notifications crash the node (xyzconstant)
Unaddressed objection: requesting a block hash past chain tip aborts with an assertion failure (zaidmstrr)
Concept support and verified via downstream Rust wallet and Electrs prototypes (darosior, Sjors, willcl-ark)
Approval from account with no project history and no stated reason (Big621)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it unblocks running the wallet in a separate process (#10102)
Exposes the core Chain interface over IPC so external tools and processes can interact with the node
